User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application (traveler, agency, or admin).

profilePicture.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

verified.description: Indicates whether the user's email is verified.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was last updated.

Agency.title: Agency
Agency.description: Represents a travel agency registered on the platform.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:1 Agency) Unique identifier for the user associated with the agency.

city.description: City where the agency is located.

wilaya.description: Province where the agency is located.

country.description: Country where the agency is located.

totalReviews.description: Number of reviews for the agency.

verified.description: Indicates whether the agency is verified.

verificationDocuments.description: Array of URLs to the agency's verification documents.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the agency was created.

Package.title: Package
Package.description: Represents a travel package offered by an agency.

agencyId.description: Reference to Agency. (Relationship: Agency 1:N Package) Unique identifier for the agency offering the package.

durationDays.description: Duration of the package in days.

maxParticipants.description: Maximum number of participants allowed for the package.

category.description: Category of the package (e.g., family, adventure).

includes.description: Array of items included in the package.

excludes.description: Array of items excluded from the package.

images.description: Array of URLs to the package images.

featured.description: Indicates whether the package is featured.

status.description: Status of the package (active, inactive, draft).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the package was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the package was last updated.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a booking made by a user for a travel package.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Booking) Unique identifier for the user who made the booking.

packageId.description: Reference to Package. (Relationship: Package 1:N Booking) Unique identifier for the package being booked.

agencyId.description: Reference to Agency. (Relationship: Agency 1:N Booking)  Unique identifier for the agency offering the package.

bookingDate.description: Date when the booking was made.

travelDate.description: Date when the travel is scheduled to begin.

numTravelers.description: Number of travelers included in the booking.

status.description: Status of the booking (pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed).

paymentStatus.description: Status of the payment for the booking (pending, paid, refunded).

paymentMethod.description: Method of payment used for the booking.

paymentId.description: Reference to Payment. (Relationship: Payment 1:1 Booking) Unique identifier for the payment associated with the booking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the booking was last updated.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a review of a travel package or agency.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Review) Unique identifier for the user who wrote the review.

packageId.description: Reference to Package. (Relationship: Package 1:N Review) Unique identifier for the package being reviewed.

agencyId.description: Reference to Agency. (Relationship: Agency 1:N Review) Unique identifier for the agency being reviewed.

bookingId.description: Reference to Booking. (Relationship: Booking 1:1 Review) Unique identifier for the booking associated with the review.

rating.description: Rating given in the review (e.g., 1-5 stars).

comment.description: Text comment included in the review.

images.description: Array of URLs to images included with the review.

verifiedBooking.description: Indicates whether the review is from a verified booking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the review was created.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment made for a booking.

bookingId.description: Reference to Booking. (Relationship: Booking 1:1 Payment) Unique identifier for the booking associated with the payment.

method.description: Method of payment used (e.g., credit card, PayPal).

transactionId.description: Transaction identifier from the payment gateway.

status.description: Status of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the payment was created.

name_ar.description: Name of the destination in Arabic.

name_fr.description: Name of the destination in French.

name_en.description: Name of the destination in English.

country.description: Country where the destination is located.

wilaya.description: Province where the destination is located.

images.description: Array of URLs to images of the destination.

featured.description: Indicates whether the destination is featured.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the destination was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post.

authorId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N BlogPost) Unique identifier for the author of the blog post.

images.description: Array of URLs to images included in the blog post.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp of when the blog post was published.

Wishlist.title: Wishlist
Wishlist.description: Represents a user's wishlist of travel packages.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist item.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Wishlist) Unique identifier for the user who owns the wishlist.

packageId.description: Reference to Package. (Relationship: Package 1:N Wishlist) Unique identifier for the package in the wishlist.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the item was added to the wishlist.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification sent to a user.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification) Unique identifier for the user who received the notification.

type.description: Type of notification (e.g., booking confirmation, payment success).

read.description: Indicates whether the notification has been read.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the notification was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to ensure security, scalability, and ease of management for the travel booking platform. It prioritizes authorization independence, clarity of intent, and follows the DBAC (Database-Based Access Control) principle. The structure facilitates secure list operations (QAPs) and maintains data integrity through denormalization and explicit state modeling.

Authorization Independence:
Authorization independence is achieved through denormalization. Specifically, for collaborative data like packages and bookings, the `agencyId` is duplicated in the `/bookings` collection, allowing rules to be written without needing to perform costly `get()` operations to verify agency ownership. For user-owned data, the path-based ownership `/users/{userId}/wishlist/{wishlistId}` is used.

QAPs Support:
*   Segregation: Collections with different access needs are segregated. For example, user profiles are stored in `/users/{userId}` ensuring that only the user can access their data. Publicly accessible destinations are stored in the `/destinations` collection.
*   Membership Model: Collaborative access is managed using the explicit `agencyId` field in the `/packages` collection, which helps in filtering the packages specific to an agency.

The design also employs structural segregation by using dedicated collections for entities with distinct security postures. For instance, user-specific data resides within `/users/{userId}/...` paths, while agency-owned packages are directly under `/packages` but include the `agencyId` field for filtering. This ensures homogeneous security requirements within each collection.

Invariants:
The structure supports integrity by enforcing path-based ownership for user-specific data and explicit `agencyId` on agency-related entities. Timestamps (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`) are included in relevant documents to track changes.
